newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares early weakness at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares early weakness at close.

text.p: Mexico's peso reined in earlier weakness at the close on Tuesday, as tentative speculation faded, traders said.
"I think the slight pressure we saw for a short while was no more than a momento of speculation in which dealers were just trying to see how far they could push the market," said a trader.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 1.1 and one centavo weaker, respectively, at 7.9050/7.9100 and 7.9000/7.9050 per dollar.
"The peso zigzagged a bit during the day, first dollars in demand and thus put the peso under pressure, but then demand faded towards the close," said another trader.
